life_event: Born on December 9, 1947 as James Godwin. Father incarcerated at a federal prison. His mother, Hazel Godwin, took James and
moved to Pocatello, Idaho and remarried shortly after.
Developed a hatred for police/ authority figures
Mother died in a potato processing plant fire.
Started having violent sexual fantasies James received counseling at St. Anthony’s Youth Correction Center in Idaho (one
of 3 stays).
Stole a car and set fire to dumpsters
Became a ward of the state James was released from reform school under the condition that he leave the state

and live with his natural father in Louisiana where he began to work in his father’s business of selling and installing chain fences. He escaped from prison by threatening a guard’s life with a knife ( His only
successful escape out of seven attempts)
Killed a colt that was tied to a tree as a Christmas gift Married first wife, Angie Bell, and had a child. Angie filed for divorce a few
months later after learning about James’ sentence to prison.
Wood commits his first rape Remarried Angie and had another child, but a few months later Angie filed for a
final divorce. James was released from Angola State Penitentiary and moved to Texas and lived with his half brother Earnest Arnold. Went to work as a truck driver for a carnival

out of Tyler, Texas. Moved out of Arnold’s home after Arnold disapproved of James’ relationship with a gay man named Jimmy Twiggs that he had met at Angola. James injured his left hand, severely cutting three of his fingers. The fingers were
surgically repaired but his hand still remained weak.
Denver, Colorado – robbed a Pizza Hut.

Pocatello, Idaho – James arrives at his cousin’s, Dave Haggard, and asks for a place to live. Haggard agrees to let him stay until he could get back on his feet. Got a job as a dishwasher at Tina’s Ox Bow Restaurant, but used his spare time to
make paintings on old handsaws and began to sell them.
Abducted and raped 15 year old Beth Edwards from a Pizza Hut parking lot.
Robbed a Subway Sandwich Shop Early Spring 45 Wood raped a 14 year old Karen, Daughter of his girlfriend 1993
Robbed Sizzler Steak house in Salt Lake City Raped a Women after picking her up off street in Salt Lake City (same day as
Sizzler Steak house Robbery) Wood abducted and killed Jeralee Underwood, age 10, a newspaper carrier in the
area. He brought her into the woods and shot and dismembered her body as she got out to use the bathroom.
Wood is arrested for the murder of Jeralee Underwood Wood is sentenced to death by lethal injection for the murder of Jeralee
Underwood. Wood confessed to killing s Louisiana woman in 1976.
Sixth district judge rejects Wood’s appeal
Idaho State Supreme Court rejects Wood’s appeal for the third time Supreme Court justice O’Connor signed a stay of execution until Wood’s death
sentence appeal could be heard by the entire U.S Supreme Court
U.S. Supreme Court refused to hear Wood’s appeal
Died from a heart attack while on death row.
